question: According to the global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2021, India’s rank is ________ out of 109 countries.
solution:
The correct answer is **__66.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to the global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2021, India's rank is **66 **out of 109 countries.
 
• The MPI is a measure that looks beyond income to understand how people experience poverty in multiple aspects of their daily lives, such as health, education, and living standards.
